ideas.title: +1 Hose Pressure 🚒
ideas.hook: A wildfire is spreading down the mountain. Every second you spray, your hose gains +1 pressure, so you can push the flames back further and reach the next ranger station.
core_loop: Spray the fire wall in front of you
Gain +1 hose pressure per second of spraying
Push forward to the next ranger station before the flames close in
Unlock a bigger fire zone (forest, town, volcano)
Rebirth for a permanent pressure multiplier
ideas.twist: Fires spread from behind too, so a squad that splits up (one sprays forward, one guards the rear) climbs much faster than a solo player.
monetization: Speed pass for running between stations
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.15 momentum across 40 new games, led by [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (24,529 CCU) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (13,765 CCU). Disaster / weather is at 1.75, carried by [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (10,383 CCU), and the "+1 ___" title formula sits at 2.16.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games grow a stat with nothing to push against; here the stat fights a hazard you can see moving toward you.

ideas.title: Golf Zombies for Cash ⛳
ideas.hook: Zombies are shambling across a golf course. Tee them up and whack them as far as you can. Every meter they fly pays out.
core_loop: Line up a zombie on the tee
Time your swing for power and angle
Watch the ragdoll zombie fly and bounce for distance cash
Buy better clubs and longer fairways
Unlock bigger, tougher zombies that pay more per meter
ideas.twist: Some zombies get back up where they land and walk toward your clubhouse, so long shots that land in the lake or a bunker are worth a bonus.
monetization: VIP club with a fire trail
Extra caddy storage for zombie types
retention: New course every zone (graveyard, mall, moon)
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the fastest-rising mechanic at 2.88 across 36 new games, led by Throw Food For Animals (238,858 CCU) and Bloody Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (15,630 CCU). Zombies is at 1.38, with Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (10,244 CCU) and [🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox (8,394 CCU) proving ragdoll zombies sell. The "___ for ___" formula is at 1.64.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games let you hurt dummies with no goal; this turns every hit into a distance score and a cash payout.

ideas.title: Draw Lightning for Cash ⚡
ideas.hook: A thunderstorm hangs over your rooftop plot. Draw copper wire paths from the sky to your batteries. Every strike your wires catch becomes cash.
core_loop: Draw wire paths across your roof before the storm
Lightning strikes follow your wires into batteries
Sell stored power for cash
Buy more batteries, better wire and taller rods
Unlock bigger storms with rarer purple and gold bolts
ideas.twist: Badly drawn wires let the bolt jump to your neighbour's roof and fill their batteries instead, so clean drawing matters.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.94 across 22 new games ([UPD1]⚽ Be a Soccer Legend at 10,767 CCU, [🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox at 8,394 CCU), and Paint / create + Disaster / weather is the top gap at 5.19. Disaster / weather is at 1.75 and Tycoon / base building at 1.27 with [⚡] Steal a Superpower! at 15,209 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Storm games make you hide from weather; here you draw the path the weather takes and get paid for it.

ideas.title: Spot the Zombie 🧟
ideas.hook: Five survivors knock on your bunker door, but one is a zombie in disguise. Ask questions, check details, and only let the humans in.
core_loop: A group of visitors lines up at the bunker window
Ask each one a question and check their answers and looks
Open the door for humans, lock out the zombie
Get it right for points; get it wrong and the zombie gets in
Survive more nights with trickier disguises
ideas.twist: In multiplayer, one player secretly plays the zombie and answers the questions live, so it becomes a bluffing game.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess is at 1.15 (Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] at 3,070 CCU, [🎃] Don't Say The Obvious! at 803 CCU) and Quiz + Zombies is an open gap at 2.46. Zombies is at 1.38, and interior maps are rising at 2.04 with Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 at 15,648 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Anomaly games make you spot one wrong thing alone; here players can be the zombie and lie to each other.

ideas.title: Sell Bait to Pirates 🏴‍☠️
ideas.hook: Pirate ships dock at your pier every few minutes. Farm worms, shrimp and glowing squid, then sell the right bait before the captain loses patience.
core_loop: Farm bait in tanks and dirt beds behind your shop
Read each pirate's order at the counter
Serve the right bait fast for gold
Upgrade tanks to grow rarer bait
Unlock bigger ships with richer captains
ideas.twist: Pirates go fishing with your bait and come back with what they caught; good bait means they share sea creatures you can display or resell.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.34 across 33 new games (Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 at 15,648 CCU, Sell a Million Sushi at 7,842 CCU) and Grow / farm is at 1.49 ([2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution at 10,789 CCU). Ocean / pirates is at 1.13.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell food to faceless NPCs; here you grow the stock yourself and each customer brings back a catch you can use.

ideas.title: Build a Mars Farm 🔴
ideas.hook: You land on Mars with one dome and a bag of seeds. Grow crops that make air and water, expand your domes, and turn the red planet green.
core_loop: Plant crops inside your dome
Harvest for food, oxygen and cash
Build new domes and rovers with the cash
Terraform the land around your base so crops grow outside
Unlock moons with alien crops
ideas.twist: Dust storms roll across Mars; crops outside the domes earn more but get wiped if you do not pull a storm shield in time.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is at 1.49 across 42 new games ([2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution 10,789 CCU, LINE UP! Metro Tycoon 9,698 CCU). Space is at 1.74 led by Sweep The Moon 🌕 (11,694 CCU), and the "Build a ___" formula is at 1.24 with Build a Bridge at 9,759 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Farm games stay on a grassy plot; here farming changes the map itself as the planet turns green around you.

ideas.title: +1 Swim Speed 🦈
ideas.hook: A shark is chasing you through a sunken shipwreck. Every stroke adds +1 swim speed. Get fast enough to reach the next air pocket.
core_loop: Swim through wreck corridors with a shark behind you
Gain +1 speed per stroke
Reach the next air pocket checkpoint
Unlock deeper wrecks with bigger sharks
Rebirth for a speed multiplier
ideas.twist: Bleeding fish bait you pick up can be dropped to slow the shark, but it also attracts sharks to other players.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.15 across 40 new games (+1 Spider Arm🕷️ 13,765 CCU), Escape / run is at 1.47 with [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! at 18,716 CCU, and interior corridor maps are up at 2.04. The "+1 ___" formula is at 2.16.
inspired_by: [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: +1 escape games run on dry tracks; this chase happens underwater in tight wreck corridors with a real predator.

ideas.title: Frost Cakes for Giants 🎂
ideas.hook: Giants line up at your bakery with photos of the cake they want. Pipe frosting on a house-sized cake to match, and get paid for how close you get.
core_loop: Take a giant's order photo
Climb the cake and pipe frosting to match it
Get scored by percentage match and paid in gold
Buy bigger cakes and new frosting colours
Unlock royal giants with harder orders
ideas.twist: You walk on the cake while you decorate, so footprints and slips ruin the design; jump pads and ladders become tools.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.94 across 22 new games and Sell / run a shop is at 1.34 (Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 15,648 CCU). Giant / huge is at 1.72 led by Raise The Biggest Family (11,390 CCU) and Bug Evolution [🦟] (10,479 CCU), and Food / candy is at 1.82.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games score a flat picture; here you decorate a giant 3D cake while standing on it.

ideas.title: Bat Moons into Orbit 🌙
ideas.hook: Your planet is bare. Swing a giant bat at passing rocks and knock them into orbit. Every moon that sticks earns cash every second.
core_loop: Wait for an asteroid to drift past
Time your swing to knock it into a stable orbit
Each moon in orbit pays passive cash
Buy bigger bats and tractor beams
Unlock rare ice and gold moons
ideas.twist: Moons can collide; a bad swing can knock another player's moon out of their orbit and into yours.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top mechanic at 2.88 (Throw Food For Animals at 238,858 CCU) and Space is at 1.74 led by Sweep The Moon 🌕 (11,694 CCU). Tycoon / base building sits at 1.27 across 81 new games with [⚡] Steal a Superpower! at 15,209 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games score one throw and reset; here every good hit stays in orbit and keeps paying.

ideas.title: Riddle the Dragon 🐉
ideas.hook: A dragon sleeps on a pile of gold. Answer its riddles to grab a handful of coins. Answer wrong and it wakes up.
core_loop: Sneak up to the dragon's hoard
Answer a riddle or guess question
Right answers let you grab gold, wrong ones wake the dragon
Run before you get burned
Spend gold on armor that buys extra wrong answers
ideas.twist: Players can whisper fake answers to rivals in proximity chat, so trust becomes part of the quiz.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess is at 1.15 across 9 new games (Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] 3,070 CCU, [UPD] Find The Country 🌍 1,026 CCU) and Quiz + Fantasy / medieval is an open gap at 2.11. Fantasy / medieval is at 1.23 with Ride a Dragon at 2,145 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games are two players at a desk; here every answer is a risky step toward a sleeping dragon.
